pitch:
UniDash: one phone app with every deadline, exam notice and announcement from your university in one feed, with alerts.
Free for you: your university pays for it. You sign in with your college Microsoft account.
Coming later: clubs and events, then marks and email.
For this panel: "buys" means you would install it and still use it every week a month later; "purchases in the first month" means how many of the first 4 weeks you would use it.
For the price questions, answer in ₹ per month: what you would pay yourself if your university did not pay for it.
